children.lean_statement: ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ f : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → UpperSemicontinuous f → ConcaveOn ℝ {x | 0 < f x} (fun x => Real.log (f x)) → MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume → MeasureTheory.integral MeasureTheory.volume f = 1 → ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ ∀ x, f x ≤ Real.exp (b - a * ‖x‖)
children.nl_statement: Lemma 5.1, in density form: every nonnegative upper-semicontinuous log-concave probability density has a pointwise exponential upper bound exp(b-a*norm(x)), with a>0 and b>=0.
children.role_in_glue: Supplies the coercivity constants for the Moreau construction.

children.lean_statement: ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ f : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → UpperSemicontinuous f → ConcaveOn ℝ {x | 0 < f x} (fun x => Real.log (f x)) → (∃ x, 0 < f x) → ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 ≤ b → (∀ x, f x ≤ Real.exp (b - a * ‖x‖)) → ∃ Q : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) → ℝ, (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Q n) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (Q n) ∧ ∀ x y : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ‖fderiv ℝ (Q n) x - fderiv ℝ (Q n) y‖ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ‖x - y‖) ∧ (∀ n x, a * ‖x‖ - (b + a ^ 2 / 2) ≤ Q n x) ∧ ∀ x, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.exp (-Q n x)) Filter.atTop (nhds (f x))
children.nl_statement: Lemma 5.2 through the envelope-limit equation: a nonzero upper-semicontinuous log-concave function with an exponential tail admits finite C1 convex Moreau envelopes Q_n, with (n+1)-Lipschitz derivative, the common linear lower bound, and exp(-Q_n) converging pointwise to the original function, including its zeros.
children.role_in_glue: Constructs the convex C1 sequence from the given density and the tail constants. The derivative estimate is the hypothesis of the mollification child.

children.lean_statement: ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ Q : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) → ℝ, (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Q n) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (Q n) ∧ ∀ x y : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ‖fderiv ℝ (Q n) x - fderiv ℝ (Q n) y‖ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ‖x - y‖) → ∃ U : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) → ℝ, (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) (U n) ∧ ∀ x v : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), (2 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (U n)) x v) v ∧ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (U n)) x v) v ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * ‖v‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ n x, Q n x ≤ U n x) ∧ ∀ x, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => U n x - Q n x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
children.nl_statement: Lemma 5.2, smooth-potentials and Hessian-bounds step: any C1 convex sequence Q_n whose derivative is (n+1)-Lipschitz has smooth majorants U_n with Hessian between 2/(n+1) and n+1+2/(n+1), and U_n-Q_n tending pointwise to zero. Construct by even mollification at radius 1/(n+1) and addition of norm(x)^2/(n+1).
children.role_in_glue: Supplies positive bounded smooth Hessians while preserving the common lower bound and density limit. The existing normalization and dominated-convergence helpers finish the parent.
